Remark
[local conformal flatness via the Schouten tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0176, petersen:page-0177 1. ch4:4.7.18Let $\dim M=n>2$. (1) Show $g$ is locally conformally flat iff $W=0$ and locally there is $\psi $ with $P=2\, \mathrm{Hess}\, \psi -2(d\psi )^2+|d\psi |^2g$ (the condition $W=0$ being redundant for $n=3$). (2) Show that if $g$ is locally conformally flat then $( abla _XP)(Y,Z)=( abla _YP)(X,Z)$.
